definition: a big board that shows advertisements
description: A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

de.answer: Sie macht ein Selfie mit dem Mann.
